definitions.ask: Should the NEEDS ATTENTION callout offer a TUI key that runs `sase agent readopt`?
definitions.why: Readopt only succeeds after an out-of-TUI repair, so a one-key retry invites repeat failures

choices.label: The callout prints the exact readopt command; no new key or proc flow
Adds a confirm-gated key that runs readopt as a durable proc from the panel
